heading.en: When a balanced trial balance still hides mistakes

hook.en: Your trial balance agrees. Does that mean your books are correct? Not always: some errors leave both totals equal.
hook.kn: ನಿಮ್ಮ ತಾಳೆಪಟ್ಟಿ ತಾಳೆಯಾಗಿದೆ. ಹಾಗಾದರೆ ಪುಸ್ತಕಗಳು ಸರಿಯಾಗಿವೆಯೇ? ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ ಅಲ್ಲ: ಕೆಲವು ತಪ್ಪುಗಳು ಎರಡೂ ಮೊತ್ತಗಳನ್ನು ಸಮವಾಗಿಯೇ ಬಿಡುತ್ತವೆ.

objectives.en: Classify errors as commission, omission, principle and compensating.
Separate errors that affect the trial balance from those that do not.

narration.en: Your trial balance agrees. Does that mean your books are correct? Not always: some errors leave both totals equal.

body.en: Errors of commission: wrong amount, wrong account, wrong side, wrong totalling (casting) or carrying forward. Errors of omission: a transaction left out completely or partly. Errors of principle: violating accounting principles, such as treating capital expenditure as revenue expenditure. Compensating errors: two or more errors that cancel each other's effect.

narration.en: Errors of commission: wrong amount, wrong account, wrong side, wrong totalling (casting) or carrying forward. Errors of omission: a transaction left out completely or partly. Errors of principle: violating accounting principles, such as treating capital expenditure as revenue expenditure. Compensating errors: two or more errors that cancel each other's effect.
narration.kn: ತಪ್ಪುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ನಾಲ್ಕು ವಿಧ: ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆಯ ತಪ್ಪುಗಳು, ಬಿಟ್ಟುಹೋದ ತಪ್ಪುಗಳು, ತತ್ವದ ತಪ್ಪುಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಪರಸ್ಪರ ಸರಿದೂಗಿಸುವ ತಪ್ಪುಗಳು.

title.en: Does the error affect the trial balance?

body.en: One-sided errors affect only one account (for example, undercasting the sales book or posting to the wrong side), so the trial balance disagrees. Two-sided errors affect two accounts equally (complete omission, error of principle, posting to a wrong account of the right side), so the trial balance still agrees. That is why agreement is not conclusive proof of accuracy.

points.en: Two-sided errors: trial balance still agrees

narration.kn: ಒಂದು ಬದಿಯ ತಪ್ಪುಗಳು ತಾಳೆಪಟ್ಟಿಯನ್ನು ತಾಳೆ ತಪ್ಪಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಎರಡು ಬದಿಯ ತಪ್ಪುಗಳು ತಾಳೆಪಟ್ಟಿಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಪರಿಣಾಮ ಬೀರುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ತಾಳೆಯಾಗುವುದು ಖಚಿತ ಪುರಾವೆಯಲ್ಲ.

problem.en: Classify each error and say whether it affects the trial balance: (i) Purchase of a computer ₹30,000 debited to the purchases account; (ii) Sales book undercast by ₹500; (iii) A credit purchase from Latha ₹2,000 not recorded at all; (iv) Cash paid to Ramesh ₹900 debited to Suresh's account.

steps.en: (i) Error of principle (capital item treated as goods): two-sided, no effect on the trial balance.
(ii) Error of commission (casting): one-sided, the credit side is ₹500 short, so the trial balance disagrees.
(iii) Error of complete omission: both sides missing, so the trial balance still agrees.
(iv) Error of commission (wrong account): debit side is still correct in total, so no effect on the trial balance.

answer.en: Only error (ii) makes the trial balance disagree.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Classify each error and say whether it affects the trial balance: (i) Purchase of a computer ₹30,000 debited to the purchases account; (ii) Sales book undercast by ₹500; (iii) A credit purchase from Latha ₹2,000 not recorded at all; (iv) Cash paid to Ramesh ₹900 debited to Suresh's account.

heading.en: Remember the four error families: C-O-P-C

body.en: Commission (wrong amount, side, account or total), Omission (left out), Principle (capital vs revenue mix-up), Compensating (cancel out). Ask: "Did both sides change by the same amount?" If yes, the trial balance still agrees.
